name: Impetus of Hecate
description:
You have dominion over [gold]past[/gold], [orange]present[/orange], and [yellow]future[/yellow], granting the following spell effects:

  • [gold]Past[/gold]: You reflect after every 3rd spell cast, causing your next spell tome swing to recast your last spell at no XP cost.

  • [orange]Present[/orange]: You gain 25% runic spell power, and [effect:mag][dark-gray]magic weapon[/dark-gray][/effect] kills collect loot and XP.

  • [yellow]Future[/yellow]: You can sneak swing a spell tome to scry, casting its rightmost spell regardless of your current selection.

[dark-gray]"Three paths, intertwined. Master this, master them."[/dark-gray]

effects.explanation: Spell tomes, Hawking Warp, Newton Meteors
